name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.232: Follow-up to 231 — the identifying agent now rides on every SubDL call, not only on
    the main ones. The plugin builds its SubDL clients at several places, and four of them (the
    status probe, the quota read, the upload postprocessing check and the upload pipeline's own
    pass) sent no agent at all, so their calls arrived unidentified. One factory builds all of them
    now.
